title: liste/1: a list of the user (transformations, adducts or suspects)
description: Written by mzlab-feat `liste` from a CSV with an error for every wrong row. Canonical JSON: keys in alphabetical order, items sorted by name and change; its SHA-256 enters prov/1. Field names in Italian, values in English, as disegno/1.

delta.description: transformations and adducts: element -> signed count of the change of formula (never 0)

ripetizioni_max.description: transformations: times the change may repeat; null = the default of the rules

massa.description: suspects: monoisotopic mass; formula or massa is set
